parameters.name: X-FW-CSRF
parameters.description: Mandatory for cookie authority; forbidden as cookie fallback for native bearer; conditional rule enforced by server.

Error.description: No sensitive value echo. REPLAY_EXPIRED means original command committed; outcome=committed, resultRef required by semantic rule. No automatic re-execution. Malformed transport failures may have no JSON body.

DeviceBearer.description: Collector-only token bound workspace/device/epochs; only ingestNotifications and reconcileReceipts. Never owner finance/plan/auth authority.

SchedulerSignature.name: X-FW-Service-Signature
SchedulerSignature.description: Private mTLS plus timestamp/nonce/body signature; anti-replay. Not a static public bearer.

OwnerBearer.description: Authenticated human-owner native session, separate audience/capability from collector token. Opaque access token, server checks subject/family/expiry/revoke.

NativeRefreshBearer.description: Refresh credential accepted ONLY by renewNativeSession; rotating family with reuse detection, not finance/collector access.

ServiceMTLS.description: Private P2 service identity; signature alone does not make endpoint public.

DeviceRenewalBearer.description: Collector credential accepted only by renewCollectorCredential with collector-key proof and live30day authorization. Expired access<=7days may be renewal-only authority, never ingest/reconcile authority. Rotation replay rules apply.

x-finweave-policy.money: VND integer string, <=18 digits; no exponent/separators/leading zeros
x-finweave-policy.quantity: <=18 integer digits, <=8 fractional; stock share/gold chi; luong converted x10 with evidence
x-finweave-policy.time: business dates YYYY-MM-DD; instants RFC3339 offset; Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh; half-open periods
x-finweave-policy.null: required nullable must be present; optional absent only when not in required; unknown metrics carry reason
x-finweave-policy.privacy: T1 trusted server processes finance; app-admin/collector/Agent capabilities restricted. HTTPS, scoped auth, data minimization and SEC-REAL-T1 controls required before real. Infrastructure/root/DBA/backup operators trusted; no anti-root-Ops claim.
